items.title: Root the per-story transition lock at the stable main repo root instead of the worktree path
items.context: transition-orchestrator.ts: resolve transitionLockRoot via detectDoneStoryWorktreeContext()?.mainRepoRoot ?? ctx.root before acquireStoryTransitionLock, so a winning DONE's worktree teardown cannot delete the lock directory a concurrent loser is polling on.

happy.desc: A single story_advance --phase=DONE call still acquires and releases the transition lock normally and the story reaches DONE, confirmed by worktree-authority-smoke.js's other assertions continuing to pass

edge.desc: Two concurrent story_advance --phase=DONE processes race the same story from its own worktree; exactly one succeeds and the loser blocks on a lock rooted at the stable main repo root, which the winner's worktree teardown cannot delete out from under it

adversarial.desc: The loser is deliberately given a slow poll interval so it wakes up strictly after the winner has already deleted the worktree, forcing the exact race window this fix targets

items.title: Translate the losing racer's post-wakeup StoryArtifactMissingError into a clean, expected message
items.context: transition-orchestrator.ts: when store.readStory(args.storyId) throws StoryArtifactMissingError AND ctx.root no longer exists on disk, throw a clear 'a concurrent DONE transition already completed and removed this worktree' error instead of letting the raw ENOENT-style message propagate.

happy.desc: A normal read of an existing story's index.json (root present) never triggers the translation catch and behaves exactly as before

edge.desc: The loser's store.readStory throws StoryArtifactMissingError while ctx.root no longer exists on disk (worktree deleted by the winner); the loser's stderr contains 'a concurrent DONE transition ... already completed and removed it' instead of a raw 'File not found' stack trace

adversarial.desc: A genuinely invalid/nonexistent storyId is passed while ctx.root still exists on disk; the original StoryArtifactMissingError must rethrow unchanged, not be misclassified as a concurrent-DONE explanation

items.title: Reject the retired lattice-review-channel lane in reviewer_list forceReviewer instead of exercising it as forceable
items.context: field-regression-cli-smoke.ts assertReviewerListForceReviewerLaneContract: remove channel from the forceable-lane assertion and add a case asserting reviewer_list --forceReviewer=channel is rejected with 'not supported by review_run_start', matching prompt-role-contract-registry.ts's structural retirement of the lane.

happy.desc: reviewer_list --forceReviewer for an active lane (e.g. docs, behavior) still returns that lane as forced, unaffected by the channel-lane change

edge.desc: reviewer_list --storyId=<id> --forceReviewer=channel is rejected with an error matching 'not supported by review_run_start' and a non-zero exit code

adversarial.desc: assertReviewerListForceReviewerLaneContract no longer asserts channel as forceable anywhere in the function, confirmed by re-reading the diff after the edit

items.title: Route the pass-only finding_add CLI-surface assertion through an active review lane instead of the retired channel lane
items.context: field-regression-cli-smoke.ts assertPassOnlyFindingConvertsToReviewPassCliSurface: swap the RP-004 case from lattice-review-channel to lattice-review-test-coverage (start a real review_run_start for that lane), matching finding wording to the PASS_ONLY_REVIEW_FINDING_POLICY pattern so the conversion behavior under test is still exercised.

happy.desc: A real review_run_start for lattice-review-test-coverage returns a reviewRunId, and the RP-004 finding_add call with matching pass-only wording converts to a recorded review pass attributed to lattice-review-test-coverage

edge.desc: The RP-004 desc text 'Test coverage review passed: no findings.' matches PASS_ONLY_REVIEW_FINDING_POLICY's wording heuristic so the conversion actually fires (verified previously by testing that a non-matching desc silently became a Finding instead)

adversarial.desc: No lingering reference to lattice-review-channel remains anywhere in assertPassOnlyFindingConvertsToReviewPassCliSurface after the swap

items.title: Add standalone RED scripts proving both defects pre-fix, registered or exempted per the RED-harness registration guard
items.context: tests/red/red-B-new-concurrent-done-race.mjs and tests/red/red-B-new-retired-channel-lane.mjs, each using spawnSync with a real file-descriptor for stdio (execFileSync's pipe capture truncates large synchronous crash dumps at 8192 bytes on macOS); register both in red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs's REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS since each throws once its own fix lands.

happy.desc: Both RED scripts run cleanly (exit 0, no crash) against the current, already-fixed dist build

edge.desc: Each RED script's own top-level assertion (that the target smoke test STILL exhibits the pre-fix defect) now itself fails with exit 1, since the underlying smoke test now passes -- this is the expected GREEN signal for a RED script

adversarial.desc: red-b49d4-harness-registration.mjs's meta-guard passes with both new RED scripts either registered in validate.commands or listed in REGISTRATION_EXCLUSIONS with a reason

items.title: Add readManifest to every pass-only finding_add call and restructure the DONE-ready story fixture to bind real reviewRunId evidence
items.context: field-regression-cli-smoke.ts: finding_add requires readManifest (filesReadFully/filesTriagedByName/scanEscalationReason) whenever the desc text matches PASS_ONLY_REVIEW_FINDING_POLICY, across all RP-001..RP-008 pass-only calls in assertPassOnlyFindingConvertsToReviewPassCliSurface. In assertDoneMergeCleansMainUntrackedReviewPasses, split writeDoneReadyStory into writeDoneReadyStory (writes phase=REVIEW, no hand-crafted review-passes.json) plus a new finishDoneReadyStory (writes phase=TEST after real review evidence lands), since a hand-crafted review pass lacks both a valid _hash signature and a genuine reviewRunId binding that validateEvidenceRunBinding now requires.

happy.desc: All RP-001..RP-008 pass-only finding_add calls in assertPassOnlyFindingConvertsToReviewPassCliSurface succeed with readManifest supplied

edge.desc: writeDoneReadyStory now writes phase=REVIEW (not TEST) and no hand-crafted review-passes.json; finishDoneReadyStory writes phase=TEST only after real review evidence has landed

adversarial.desc: A hand-signed review pass without a valid _hash/reviewRunId would fail validateEvidenceRunBinding -- confirmed this restructure avoids that path entirely by using real review_run_start + review_pass_set calls instead

items.title: Satisfy the full 3-lane review-assurance-floor quorum and record dev_memory_finish_decision before the DONE-ready fixture advances to DONE
items.context: field-regression-cli-smoke.ts assertDoneMergeCleansMainUntrackedReviewPasses: DONE now requires all three opt-in reviewer lanes (concept, quality, test-coverage) each with a genuine review_run_start-bound review_pass_set, not just one lane (review_lane_missing); also call dev_memory_finish_decision before story_advance phase=DONE, matching the B-a7c5 dev-memory lifecycle gate added earlier this session.

happy.desc: assertDoneMergeCleansMainUntrackedReviewPasses's DONE-ready fixture loops over all three opt-in lanes (lattice-review-quality, lattice-review-concept, lattice-review-test-coverage), each with a real review_run_start-bound review_pass_set

edge.desc: dev_memory_finish_decision is called before story_advance --phase=DONE in the fixture, matching the B-a7c5 dev-memory lifecycle gate

adversarial.desc: Omitting any one of the three lanes would reproduce 'Expected 3 reviewers ... Covered N/3' (review_lane_missing) -- this was the actual failure observed and fixed during this story's own investigation
